caption:
Not all exhaustion is the same. Physical fatigue shows up heavy in the muscles — the kind a rest day and good nutrition fix. Mental fatigue shows up heavy in the chest, and it needs a different kind of recovery: mental rest, not just physical rest. Mixing the two up is how athletes stay 'rested' but still feel burnt out.

#MentalFatigue #AthleteRecovery #SportsPsychology
